no_adcom_quote.quote: The Division did not identify questions or concerns requiring discussion by external consultants, the Psychopharmacologic Drugs Advisory Committee, or the Drug Safety and Risk Management Advisory Committee.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the DAYVIGO (lemborexant) NDA212028 approval. The FDA Multidisciplinary Review's Section 9 (Advisory Committee Meeting and Other External Consultations) states the Division did not identify questions or concerns requiring discussion by external consultants or the relevant advisory committees. Safety concerns (somnolence, next-day impairment, parasomnias) were instead addressed through labeling modifications and postmarketing requirements, with no AdComm influence on the approval.
